verses.1: Hallelujah! Hallelujah! Praise Him in His holiness! Praise Him in the heavens!
verses.2: Hallelujah in his greatness! Hallelujah, for he is so great!
verses.3: Hallelujah in the trumpet’s sound! Hallelujah in the harp and in the lyre.
verses.4: Hallelujah in the heights and on the mountains! Hallelujah in the depths and in the heights.
verses.5: Hallelujah in the shofar’s sound! Hallelujah in the loud trumpet’s cry!
verses.6: All souls shall praise Him. Praise Him, O Lord!
